title: Bandleader of the Florida Tip Top Shows carnival
summary: He led the band for Billy Wonder's Florida Tip Top Shows, playing ballyhoo and show music with seven to ten men.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: But you were with a carnival, by now. In Florida, right?
So I was in the carnival, and --
What was the name of the carnival?
It was Florida Tip Top Shows.
Yeah, owned by Billy Wonder, and I worked with them -- I became band leader over there.
What kind of band was that, Herman? Was this again a marching band kind of --
Yes, it was -- yeah. Well, you had to double on and off. In other words, you go out and make bally-hoo to draw the people in.
Then you have to set down there and play the show, the singers, the dancers, the buck dancers, and whatnot, whoever they were. You know. And --
How big a band was that?
Well it varied. Sometimes seven, eight, eight, ten. Two trombones, maybe two trumpets. Bass. Baritone. And I never forget -- you know, a lot of jobs -- well
